summary: Takeda filed a Form 6-K announcing FDA approval of its drug ORZEYFUL (oveporexton) for narcolepsy type 1. This is a routine regulatory product approval announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The filing includes clinical trial results and launch preparation details but no financial terms, advisors, or shareholder actions. Accordingly, this filing does not meet the special-situations classification criteria.
